notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 400 x 300; the first setOption at T0.
events in order at T0 + t; a sample is zr.animation.update(), a refresh of the display list, and a read of what the case's probes name.

cases.note: a merge changes every row: each polyline updateProps its points from the old ones (update timing, 1000 ms linear, its row)
the same with animationDelayUpdate idx * 100: each row waits its turn
a merge drops the last row and adds two: the kept ones move, the new ones are at their place at once, the dropped one is gone
a merge changes the values: each kept layer's polygon updateProps its points and stacked-on points (update timing, no row)
a merge drops layer b and adds layer c: a is kept and moves, c enters with its clip, b is gone at once
a merge changes the links' values: every piece and every ribbon updateProps its shape (update timing, its row)
a merge drops a link and a node: the dropped ribbon and piece fade out (removeElementWithFadeOut), the rest move
a merge moves the lines' ends: each Line updateProps its shape (update timing, its row); the end symbols follow the line every frame
curved lines (curveness 0.3): the control point tweens with the ends

guards.name: par-delay: the last row has not started at +150
